data.one_liner: Upload files to a server in chunks using Dio for mobile, desktop, and web.
data.what_it_does: Allows uploading large files in smaller chunks to prevent memory issues and handle interrupted transfers. Supports both file paths and data streams for web compatibility.
use_when: You need to upload large files to a backend server
You are using Dio for network requests
You need to support file uploads on web, mobile, and desktop
avoid_when: You are not using Dio as your HTTP client
You only need simple single-request file uploads
strengths: Supports chunked file uploads across mobile, desktop, and web
Provides both stream-based and file-path-based upload methods
Allows custom headers for each chunk upload request
weaknesses: Requires Dio as the underlying HTTP client
Limited documentation beyond basic usage examples
data.setup_notes: Add chunked_uploader and dio to your dependencies.
